answer: The glacier schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the saffron checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 63 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. A hostile operator wanting 143 effective identities must lock that capital for 63 epochs and keep it locked through every garden audit. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
